scoring_justification: Paper's Figure 6a,b presents thermodynamic functions as plots only; no digitised reference table is available. Scoring uses physical structural invariants (high‑T Dulong‑Petit limit, monotonicity, thermodynamic consistency) with tolerances that accept the reference Debye‑analytic oracle as full credit.
